# Locate Animals or Plants (`spells:locate-animals-or-plants`)
**Level 2 [Divination](../magic-schools/divination.md) (Ritual)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Self
**Components:** V, S, M (fur from a bloodhound) | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md)

Describe or name a specific kind of Beast, Plant creature, or nonmagical plant. You learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.
